```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")

joined <- open_dataset("data/history.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  left_join(markets, by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric    = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    prediction_error   = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.numeric(as.Date(ymd_hms(resolved_at)) - date),
    time_bucket = factor(
      case_when(
        days_to_resolution >  90 ~ "90+ days",
        days_to_resolution >  30 ~ "30–90 days",
        days_to_resolution >   7 ~ "7–30 days",
        days_to_resolution >=  1 ~ "1–7 days",
        TRUE                     ~ "Final day"
      ),
      levels = c("90+ days", "30–90 days", "7–30 days", "1–7 days", "Final day"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

groups        <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket) |>
  summarise(mean_error = mean(prediction_error), n_rows = n(), .groups = "drop")

accuracy

ggplot(accuracy, aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```

```{r}
resolution_day <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0)

ggplot(resolution_day, aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, color = "white") +
  labs(
    x = "Forecast probability",
    y = "Number of snapshots"
  )
```

```{r}
calibration <- resolution_day |>
  mutate(probability_bin = cut(probability, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    predicted_probability = mean(probability),
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

calibration

ggplot(calibration, aes(x = predicted_probability, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "YES outcomes are rare below 10% and common above 90%",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual resolution rate",
    size = "Markets"
  )
```
